A '''professor''' taught at the [[Chiss Academy]] in the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]].<ref name="CC" /> Prior to the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|beginning]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="Explain">According to ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds: Clone Campaigns]]'', [[Sev'rance Tann/Legends|Sev'rance Tann]] had left the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]] prior to her involvement in the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|First Battle of Geonosis]], which occurred in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]] according to ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''.</ref> the [[Professor/Legends|professor]] challenged a young [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]] student named [[Sev'rance Tann/Legends|Sev'rance Tann]] to train a group of creatures called the [[Yresilini]], believed to be untrainable, into an [[Army/Legends|army]]. Tann succeeded in her assignment by intimidating the Yresilini with the fear of [[Death/Legends|death]] as a punishment for disobedience, and the professor gave high marks for her performance.<ref name="CC" />

==Behind the scenes==
The professor was mentioned in Sev'rance Tann's databank entry in the [[2002]] [[LucasArts]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds: Clone Campaigns]]''.<ref name="CC" />
